name: Hybrid Scanline A-Buffer Volume Rendering
definition: A hybrid rendering system that uses a fast scanline a-buffer algorithm for surface-defined objects and volume rendering for procedural gases, combining them via Z-sorted a-buffer fragments.
summary: Hybrid Scanline A-Buffer Volume Rendering combines fast scanline a-buffer algorithms for solids with volume rendering for translucent media, distinguishing itself by explicitly handling volumetric opacity and attenuation through sorted volume fragments.
